title: Merge Intervals
summary: Collapse a list of intervals so no two of them overlap.
statement:
Each entry of `intervals` is a pair `[start, end]` with `start <= end`. Merge every pair that overlaps or touches, and return the result sorted by start.

Two intervals touch when one ends exactly where the next begins: `[1, 4]` and `[4, 5]` merge into `[1, 5]`.

### Constraints

- 1 ≤ intervals.length ≤ 10,000
- -10⁹ ≤ start ≤ end ≤ 10⁹
- The input is **not** sorted

### Example

```
[[1,3], [2,6], [8,10], [15,18]]  ->  [[1,6], [8,10], [15,18]]
```

> **Sort first**
>
> Once the intervals are in order of start, an interval can only ever overlap the one you are currently building — so a single pass finishes the job. Without sorting you are back to comparing every pair.
